pharma.title: India to roll out digital drug regulatory system soon: DCGI
pharma.summary: The Drugs Controller General of India (DCGI) announced that India will soon roll out a comprehensive digital drug regulatory system to streamline pharmaceutical oversight. The portal aims to enhance transparency and improve administrative efficiency across the drug regulatory framework.
pharma.source_title: India to roll out digital drug regulatory system soon: DCGI - Indian Pharma Post

pharma.title: Centre reviews hospital consumable pricing after 2,841 percent markup finding
pharma.summary: The Central government has initiated a review of hospital consumable pricing following reports revealing profit markups as high as 2,841 percent on medical items. Officials are analyzing cost structures to protect healthcare consumers from exorbitant hospital billing practices.
pharma.source_title: Centre reviews hospital consumable pricing after 2,841 percent markup finding - Medical Buyer

pharma.title: Pacemakers to syringes: Why India needs fair pricing for medical devices
pharma.summary: Concerns regarding excessive trade margins on vital medical supplies ranging from syringes to pacemakers have intensified calls for price control mechanisms. Industry experts emphasize that fair pricing regulation is critical to making essential medical devices affordable.
pharma.source_title: Pacemakers to syringes: Why India needs fair pricing for medical devices - The Indian Express

national.title: PM Modi Becomes Longest-Serving Elected Head of Government in India
national.summary: Narendra Modi has achieved the milestone of becoming the longest-serving elected head of government in India's political history. This record accounts for his combined service as Chief Minister of Gujarat and Prime Minister of India.

national.title: Government to test Digi Yatra at major airports for international departures between October and December
